elaine: heads up — mkdocs build failing linkcheck for /guides/deploy#instance-config. the heading exists on the page but linkcheck reports 404. build log snippet below:
```
WARNING - broken link: /guides/deploy.md#instance-config -> 404
```

jason: saw this after we flipped the `slugify` mode in mkdocs-material. try adding an explicit header id like `### Instance config {#instance-config}` or pin slugify to `github`.

maya: where is the mkdocs.yml living in the repo now? I can repro if I run the same linkcheck locally.

elaine: mkdocs.yml currently (excerpt):
```yaml
site_name: Redwood Docs
theme:
  name: material
  language: en
markdown_extensions:
  - toc:
      permalink: '¶'
  - attr_list
slugify: v0.11
use_directory_urls: false
```

lucas: I can open a tiny PR to add explicit id on the deploy page and fix any example anchors. assigning to myself.

elaine: thanks — can you also run `mkdocs build --strict` locally and `mkdocs-linkcheck`? CI caught it but sometimes local runs show other warnings.

ci-bot: pipeline #4231: linkcheck failed on commit 9f2b7e5 — https://ci.internal/runs/4231 (details in pipeline log).

taylor: quick note — some code examples in the page use underscores in inline anchors like `[foo_bar](#foo_bar)`. depending on slugify that may become `#foo-bar`. easiest fix is explicit ids or normalizing anchors in examples.

lucas: opened PR #5123: adds `{#instance-config}` and fixes example anchors; also added `<!-- mkdocs: anchor-explicit -->` comment for clarity. requesting review from docs-owners.

priya: reviewed, left one nit about language tags on codeblocks. LGTM otherwise. :thumbsup:

elaine: merging once CI turns green. thanks everyone for fast turnaround!
